name: fhold
description: fhold CLI — install and manage a self-hosted fhold stack

scripts.test: bun test --isolate src/main.test.ts src/commands/*.test.ts src/compiled-boundary.test.ts src/lib/*.test.ts
scripts.build: bun run pack:embedded && bun build src/main.ts --compile --no-compile-autoload-dotenv --no-compile-autoload-bunfig --outfile dist/fhold-cli
scripts.build:linux-x64: bun run pack:embedded && bun build src/main.ts --compile --no-compile-autoload-dotenv --no-compile-autoload-bunfig --target=bun-linux-x64 --outfile dist/fhold-cli-linux-x64
scripts.build:linux-arm64: bun run pack:embedded && bun build src/main.ts --compile --no-compile-autoload-dotenv --no-compile-autoload-bunfig --target=bun-linux-arm64 --outfile dist/fhold-cli-linux-arm64
